lore.origin: Corpses left in Ether-touched tombs without rites; hunger for warm flesh and remembered names.
lore.description: Hunched, dirt-caked dead with too many teeth and tomb-clay under their nails.

traits.name: Rise Again
traits.text: When reduced to 0 HP, DC 13 consecration or decapitation within 1 round or returns to 1d6 HP once.

actions.name: Claw
actions.text: 1d6+3 slashing + 1d4 necrotic; DC 12 STA save or Paralyzed until end of next turn.
